title: Prove at room temperature
vo: Line a bowl with a clean tea towel, and flour it well. Lay the dough in, seam side up. Cover it, and leave it at room temperature for an hour and a half to 2 hours, until it looks puffy. Poke it with a floured finger. When the dent springs back slowly, it's ready.
voUS: Line a bowl with a clean tea towel, and flour it well. Lay the dough in, seam side up. Cover it, and leave it at room temperature for an hour and a half to 2 hours, until it looks puffy. Poke it with a floured finger. When the dent springs back slowly, it's ready.
cap: Line a bowl with a well-floured tea towel. Lay the dough in, seam side up.
Cover and leave at room temperature for 1½ to 2 hours, until puffy.
Poke it with a floured finger. When the dent springs back slowly, it's ready.
